name: FrostHelm
tagline: The operating system for modern cold-plunge studios.
positioning: FrostHelm gives owner-operators one platform to run bookings, water-safety compliance, memberships, and staff across every plunge location.

hero.sub: FrostHelm unifies session booking, water-safety logs, membership billing, and staff scheduling so your studio stays compliant, full, and cash-positive.

features.title: Water-Safety Compliance
features.description: Automated temperature, chlorine, and pH logging with tamper-proof records ready for any health inspector who walks through your door.

features.title: Plunge Scheduling
features.description: Manage limited-capacity tub slots, contrast-therapy rotations, and buffer times across every location from one live calendar.

features.title: Membership & Billing
features.description: Sell recurring plunge memberships, day passes, and class packs with automatic dunning and per-location revenue reporting.

features.title: Staff & Attendant Rosters
features.description: Assign certified attendants to each session, track cold-exposure safety briefings, and enforce staffing minimums in real time.

features.title: Multi-Location Control
features.description: Compare occupancy, utilization, and margin across all your studios with a single owner dashboard built for portfolios.

features.title: Member Waivers
features.description: Collect signed liability and medical-screening waivers at checkout, then attach them to every session on record automatically.

testimonials.quote: Before FrostHelm our sanitation logs lived on a clipboard by the tubs. Now inspections take ten minutes and our attendants never miss a reading.
testimonials.name: Danielle Roarke

testimonials.quote: We opened two more studios in a year because FrostHelm let me see occupancy and margin per location without spreadsheets. The per-seat pricing scaled cleanly with my team.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Membership churn dropped 18% after we moved billing and waivers onto FrostHelm. My front desk finally stopped chasing paperwork and started selling packs.
testimonials.name: Priya Vashwani
